The certificate list on page 274 names every closed-list course; if a reviewer confirms the A.S. degree requirements match the certificate (common at Sacramento City College), the degree would hold: required CISA 305, CISA 315, CISA 323, CISA 340, CISC 305, CISC 310, CISC 320 or CISC 323, CISP 301, CISP 360; a minimum of 4 units from CISP 400/CISP 401; a minimum of 4 units from CISA 306, CISA 316, CISC 324, CISC 355, CISC 360, CISP 350; a minimum of 6 units from a longer list (including CISD/CISP 357, CISD/CISP 358, CISN, CISP, CISS and CISW courses); total 35 units.

Student Learning Outcomes and Career Information printed after the certificate list belong to that certificate section; they were not copied for the A.S. degree because the text does not show that the degree shares them.
Following sections (Network Administration, Network Design, PC Support, Programming, Web Developer certificates) belong to other programs and were not read.
